issues: 四象限是大块空面板 + 灰骨架条，标签写着 “METRIC 1/2/3”，表格只有五根灰条，特写后画面大片空白
光标点下去界面毫无反应，涟漪只是一个细环，“指点”没有落到任何具体控件上
相机用对称 inOutCubic，角到角是平直滑移，途中看不到全局位置；快速过渡没有运动模糊
光标与相机同步直线平移、点击时箭头不动，读作贴图而不是手在操作
背景是死平的 #080910，窗口只有单层黑影
changes: 四象限换成出版级深色 dashboard：指标卡（Active users / Conversion / p95 load + 涨跌 + sparkline）、Catmull-Rom 平滑面积折线 + 网格 + 日期轴、带月份的柱状图、带色点/占比条/数值的渠道表，全部 tabular-nums
四个落点按布局反推各对准一个控件，点击即响应：指标卡选中描边 + 辉光、折线数据点放大 + 引导线 + tooltip（Sep 21 · 4,812）、柱子点亮 + 数值标签、表格行选中；离开该站淡到 40%
相机改不对称 bezier(0.55,0,0.18,1)，角到角途中 s 拉远 ~9% 再推回（hop），按 world 中心点的屏幕速度加 SpeedBlur（amount 0.18，上限 10px）
光标沿垂直方向走 ~2.5% 轻弧、与相机同时到位；按下 3f 缩到 0.86 后 overshoot 回弹；涟漪改细环 + 软光盘，箭头换双层投影
背景改暗场 Backdrop（柔光 + 靛紫余光 + 暗角 + 颗粒），窗口发丝线边 + 两层深色软影 + 顶部内高光
issuesEn: The four quadrants are big empty panels with grey skeleton bars labelled 'METRIC 1/2/3', the table is five grey bars, and close-ups are mostly empty
Clicking does nothing to the UI; the ripple is a single thin ring and the pointing never lands on a specific control
The camera uses symmetric inOutCubic with flat corner-to-corner slides, never revealing the overall layout in transit, and fast moves have no motion blur
The cursor glides in a straight line locked to the camera and the arrow never reacts on click, reading as a sticker rather than a hand
The background is a dead flat #080910 and the window has only a single black shadow
changesEn: Quadrants are now a publication-grade dark dashboard: metric tiles (Active users / Conversion / p95 load with deltas and sparklines), a Catmull-Rom smoothed area line chart with grid and date axis, a bar chart with month labels, and a channel table with colour dots, share bars and values, all tabular-nums

The four landing points are solved from the layout so each hits a real control, and every click responds: tile selection ring and glow, chart point growth with guide line and tooltip (Sep 21 · 4,812), bar highlight with value label, and table row selection; each fades to 40% when the camera leaves
The camera uses an asymmetric bezier(0.55,0,0.18,1), pulls back ~9% mid-transit between corners (hop), and gets SpeedBlur from the on-screen velocity of the world centre (amount 0.18, max 10px)

The cursor takes a ~2.5% perpendicular arc and still lands with the camera; it presses to 0.86 for 3 frames then springs back with overshoot; the ripple is a thin ring plus soft glow disc, and the arrow has a two-layer shadow
The background is a dark Backdrop (soft light, indigo tint, vignette, grain), and the window has hairline borders, a two-layer dark soft shadow and a top inner highlight
